ambient_events: The drain is flushed with a bucket of clean water. Nothing was in it.
A flask is turned in its felt so the label faces out, and set back down.
The kettle goes on. Nothing else about the room changes.
description: Set apart at the end of the row, windowless, with a drain running out from under the door to a sealed sump. The walls are double-skinned. There is a bell mounted by the door and a board beside it with a single name on it: whoever is going in next, and when.
name: The Fleshery
